# ops note

add a note

## Usage

```
ops note
```

## Global Flags

- `-h, --help` — print help
- `-v, --verbose` — say more; repeat to count: -vvv
- `--color` `string` — when to color (default `auto`) (one of auto, always, never)

## Stdin

Reads a `json` document (`object`) from stdin.

- `text` `string` — the note
